value.rationale: Iteration is a natural structural question for jump-like operators, and the source's semantic switch could a priori change after feedback. The theorem shows that it never does at finite stages and gives exact classical models for both orbit regimes. This turns a one-step counterexample into a complete finite-dynamical description and exposes the new operator as a glued ordinary-jump/hyperjump system.
